description: For a domain's current certificate (taken from public Certificate Transparency data via CertSpotter): reads its CRL Distribution Point, downloads that public CRL, and reports whether the certificate's serial number is on it, plus the CRL's thisUpdate and nextUpdate. OCSP is not queried. Revocation status is as of the CRL's publication time. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_cert_revocation_crl
title: Security Cert Revocation Crl
